versions.content: The function WdgM_MainFunction shall calculate the Global Supervision Status in every Supervision Cycle. The function shall compute the Global Supervision Cycle after it computed every Local Supervision Status. The cyclic update of Global Supervision Status is necessary to trigger the timely transition from WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_EXPIRED to WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_STOPPED.
